verdict.rationale: Canny documents automatic feedback capture integrations with Gong, Intercom, Slack and other sources, plus an MCP server for ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor with 'no API keys, no engineering' setup, supporting quick third-party connections. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated integrations marketplace/directory or step-by-step click-through setup UI beyond the MCP sign-in flow. Missing for 10: a broader integrations catalog page, screenshots/hands-on walkthrough of the connection UI, and independent confirmation of ease-of-setup beyond vendor claims.
